# 🤖 AI Code Review & Generation Guidelines

## Language Rules

- Write all user-facing review comments, code suggestions, explanations, and follow-up notes in Korean.
- If a quoted identifier, API name, error message, commit message, or code snippet is in English, keep that quoted content unchanged.

## Review Focus

- For backend design, implementation, or review, consult `docs/AGENTS.backend.template.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` from the repository root.
- When performing a code review, focus on readability and avoid nested ternary operators.
